label: 2. Sorry for bothering you all at this late hour,

lines.text: Unlocks: Clear event stage 103710105 · After Lion Cubs chat 1. Leona has invited {AccountData.NickName} to jo…

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Sorry for bothering you all at this late hour,

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: but I just wanted to express my gratitude to Guillotine

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: for taking such good care of the animals.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: I'm also incredibly grateful to you for taking the harassment from the fanatics in stride.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Yeah, thanks a bunch.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: I was talking with the dogs,

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: and they said they had a blast.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Usually, they're a bit restless when it's time for bed,

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: but they're all sawing logs right now.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: You're amazing!

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: The cats all look like they had fun as well.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: They've been talking about you all day, Guillotine.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Thank you, meow.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Glad to be of service.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: However, I must remain in the shadows,

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: so I think I will have to leave this group chat.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: That's too bad.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: So, whenever I need you,

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: all I do is look in the sky and shout your name?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Precisely.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Our fates are all intertwined, and reside under the same sheltering sky.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Say my name, and I will hear your call.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Since I cannot leave any trace,

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I must go.
Guillotine left the group chat.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Phew.
How have things been since we left the shelter?

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Fine.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Just fine.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Oh right, Zoo Keeper.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: There was something I wanted to talk to you about.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Could I come see you tomorrow morning?
Sure.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: All right, it's getting late, so I'll quit pestering you guys.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Goodnight, everyone!

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Goodnight.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Night, meow.
